_meta.title: Global Database on Intergenerational Mobility (GDIM), World Bank 2023
_meta.what: How much a person's education depends on their parents' education, for people born in the 1940s-1980s. value = correlation between children's and parents' years of schooling (0 = no link, 1 = children's schooling fully follows parents'; higher = less mobility, a sign of class rigidity), for the 1980s cohort, using the more-educated parent and all children. BHQ4 = chance that a child of bottom-half parents reaches the top quarter. Every row of the source (by cohort, mother/father/max/average parent, son/daughter/all children) is kept in "rows", in the order of _meta.row_columns.
_meta.source: World Bank, Global Database on Intergenerational Mobility, version 3 (March 2023)
